verdict.rationale: pnpm is itself an official, self-contained CLI, documented at pnpm.io/pnpm-cli. It exposes automation-friendly behaviour an agent can drive: JSON audit output, dry-run installs that write nothing to disk, automatic frozen-lockfile mode in CI, and scriptable fixes like `pnpm audit --fix`. Community users confirm everyday CLI use (`pnpm store prune`, recursive commands). Missing for 10: documented machine-readable output beyond audit, agent/LLM-oriented CLI docs (llms.txt returns 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Output audit report in JSON format.
Run a full dependency resolution and report what a real install would change, without writing anything to disk.
When pnpm detects that it is running in CI, it switches to frozen-lockfile mode automatically.
